flows:
Navigate to https://www.unitconverters.net/ then Use the locked 320 CSS pixel viewport and scroll vertically only.
Stay on this public site.
Do not sign in, register, pay, or interact with a CAPTCHA or access challenge.
Leave fixture settings unchanged.
Use visible controls only.
In the Length converter, assert that the complete To value field fits within the 320-pixel viewport.
Enter 1 in From with Meter and Kilometer selected.
Verify 0.001 appears in To without horizontal scrolling.

remark: analyze: the complete To value field fits within the 320-pixel viewport
assert: the complete To value field fits within the 320-pixel viewport
type: Entering 1 in the From unit input

summary:
You asked to set up the Length converter with 1 meter as the starting value and kilometers as the destination unit.
The converter’s destination value field was fully visible in the 320-pixel-wide view.
Entered 1 with Meter selected in From and Kilometer selected in To.
The conversion completed successfully, showing 0.001 in the To field.
one_liner: converted 1 meter to kilometers on unitconverters.net
